title: MeshRTC-Agents: software agents for robotic transport platforms coordinated by short Meshtastic commands (synthetic digital twin, Colab notebook)

creators.name: Prokopovych-Tkachenko, Dmytro
creators.affiliation: University of Customs and Finance, Dnipro, Ukraine

description:
Python package and Google Colab notebook with software agents for robotic transport platforms that deliver medicines and drinking water during deep power outages and are coordinated by short commands over a Meshtastic LoRa mesh.

Contents: (1) a compact command protocol (task contract, status, decision, blockage, receipt, site closure, request, auction bid, lease, recall, relay deployment, risk dial, reporting policy, hold) with text and binary/CRC-16 encodings, a deterministic validator, LoRa airtime (Semtech) and a 1 % duty-cycle budget model; (2) a synthetic riverside town with an Okumura-Hata radio model, cellular decay and repeaters; (3) agents: crisis-coordination orchestrator, comms steward, robot agents with Stop-on-loss, Fixed-route and the Supervisory Feasibility Controller (chance-constrained energy predicates, online calibration, localisation guard), recipient nodes and a relay UGV; (4) fleet logic with store-carry-forward and in-field auctions; (5) ten transport scenarios S01-S10; (6) four NumPy neural modules: a deep-ensemble energy predictor used inside the chance constraint, a behaviour-cloned supervisory policy under a runtime-assurance shield, a mesh-contact predictor and an operator intent parser that turns Ukrainian/English free text into validated short commands; (7) paired Monte-Carlo experiments, 39 figures and schematic diagrams. All data are synthetic; the town is only inspired by the planning grid of Verkhnodniprovsk, Ukraine, and is not a map of it.

Notebook text is in Ukrainian; code, figures and README are in English.
notes: Software supplement to the study 'Agentic Supervisory Control of a Robotic Transport Complex for Emergency Deliveries during Deep Blackouts: A Synthetic-Data Digital-Twin Study with Offline Maps and Meshtastic Backup Communication'. Related Zenodo records: 10.5281/zenodo.23460212 (BlackoutMesh-Twin), 10.5281/zenodo.23298497, 10.5281/zenodo.23298550.
